title: Space Mistakes
text: From the producers who enjoyed Apollo 13, Ad Astra, Gravity, and The Martian, comes another film about the dangers of space. Daddy, why do you have to go to space again? Because that's where I'll work, son. Promise you won't make a mistake up there? I promise. Because that would be the worst place to make one. You said last time was the last time. Baby, what are you so worried about? I'm worried you'll make a mistake. You could crack your helmet, spin too fast, push the wrong thing and the top comes off. Your tube could pop. The window could kaboom! Going to space today. You guys excited? I am. Just hope we don't make any mistakes up there. Well, you know what they say. In space, no one can hear you make a mistake. Nice. Okay, now. Ten, nine, eight. Remember, no oopsies. Got it. Seven, six. I mean it. Everything has to go perfect. We promise. Five. Dude, seatbelt. Oh, my bad. Nice catch. Four. It's not working. Three. Seatbelt first, then gloves. I forgot! Two. What did you do? What? I made a mistake. Space mistakes. Expeditor, what happened? Murphy, he made a mistake. And because it happened in space, he exploded. Damn it! Sir, he burst. A film that asks the question, what if you messed up at work, but your work was space? Oh, no. Oh, crap. I unboofed it. I dropped it. No, a mistake. What's this bug do? Mistake. Mistake. Yikes. Lefty-righty, tighty-loosey. No, no, no. Oh. It's your husband. He made a mistake. Where? In space. No! Space mistakes. See it in IMAX or on a plane. Nothing in between. Space.
